study: Defects disclosed in one surface of the template brain
what: A check of the triangle meshes of the template brain used for display. The two mid-cortical surfaces passed their closed-surface checks; the optional region-boundary surface did not.

numbers.what: open edges in the region-boundary surface (an edge that belongs to one triangle only)
edges whose two triangles face inconsistent ways
points whose ring of triangles is not a single fan

limits: A template is not the brain of any recorded subject, and a mesh check says nothing about function.
The counts describe the region-boundary surface as supplied; nothing was repaired.
credit: The template surfaces are a third party's; the counts are this project's check of them.
